H3_raw_schema_limitation: H3 TSV contains measured latency/bytes/error only, without status or warmup rows; status and completed warmups are checked through client summaries and the pinned validating harness/client.

normalization.latency: Scheduled arrival to completion; median of six arm p99 values, not pooled request p99. Service/dispatch quantiles separate, never added.
normalization.load: 15,000 R/s with bounded admission: H1=32, H2/H3=128; not unrestricted open loop or measured capacity.
normalization.process_CPU: Server plus helper user+system over entire client span; excludes kernel/IRQ charged elsewhere.
normalization.VM_CPU: All Linux CPUs user+nice+system+IRQ+softIRQ; includes clients/unrelated work; Windows host unobserved.

limitations: C7 is a fresh native rebuild of historically attributed production source, not exact deployed994127 provenance.
One-second compiler sampling does not observe sub-interval activity or Windows-host scheduling.
Any VM increases remain visible; server process CPU reductions do not establish universal overall CPU gains.
